description.value: Marland Motel is an 18-room property on the quiet edge of Powell River on BC's Sunshine Coast, offering a range of room types from simple sleeping rooms to one-bedroom family units and standalone cottages, most with full kitchens for longer stays. It sits within walking distance of restaurants and the beach, and is close to outdoor attractions including the Sunshine Coast Trail, salmon fishing charters, and scuba diving sites. Pets are welcome, making it a practical base for touring cyclists exploring the northern Sunshine Coast.
